## Why

Found in the S28 human check. run.answer with adj on refuses an empty By even when the pending question has no decision key, although FileAnswer files nothing then (internal/engine/answer_adj.go:18-20 returns before its own By check). The TUI never sends adj without a key (internal/tui/model.go:1226-1227) and `ork answer` never sends adj (internal/cli/run.go:196-201), so only a direct daemon caller hits it; the daemon should still match the engine.

- `internal/daemon/runs.go` (ownerRun, the MethodRunAnswer case near :859-862): refuse an empty p.By only when rec.Pending.Key is non-empty.
- `internal/daemon/answer_adj_test.go` (TestAnswerWithoutAdjDecidedByIsRefusedWithoutKey near :305): rename and invert.
